capabilities: Import selected vault files into Archivist campaigns
Create or list Archivist campaigns from within Obsidian
Convert note titles and cleaned markdown into entities and journal entries
Preserve and normalize wikilinks before upload
Store the Archivist API key in Obsidian Secret Storage
extras: Desktop-only until tested on mobile (isDesktopOnly: true); README is partly developer/release documentation (compliance checklist, RELEASING.md) rather than user docs; no telemetry; network requests only go to the Archivist API with an x-api-key header.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send vault notes to an outside campaign-management service, so content must be copied and reformatted by hand.
summary: Plugin that imports selected vault files into Archivist campaigns as characters, items, locations, factions and journal entries.
